messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have a built‑in function that can pull holiday calendars directly from an external service. However, I can share the list of public holidays in Canada for 2023 that typically create long weekends:

| Date | Holiday | Typical Long Weekend |
|------|---------|----------------------|
| Jan 1 (Sun) | New Year’s Day | New Year’s Eve (Dec 31) – Jan 1 |
| Apr 7 (Mon) | Good Friday | Good Friday – Easter Monday (Apr 10) |
| May 22 (Mon) | Victoria Day | May 21 (Sat) – May 23 (Mon) |
| Jul 1 (Tue) | Canada Day | July 1–2 (Tue–Wed) |
| Sep 18 (Mon) | Labour Day | Sep 17 (Sat) – Sep 19 (Mon) |
| Oct 9 (Mon) | Thanksgiving | Oct 8 (Sat) – Oct 10 (Mon) |
| Nov 20 (Thu) | Remembrance Day | Nov 20–21 (Thu–Fri) |
| Dec 25 (Mon) | Christmas | Dec 24 (Sun) – Dec 26 (Tue) |
| Dec 26 (Tue) | Boxing Day | Dec 26–27 (Tue–Wed) |

These dates are based on federal statutory holidays; provincial variations may apply. If you’d like me to look up a specific province’s holidays or confirm dates for a particular year, let me know!
